I was honored to speak to the @AmerMedicalAssn on addressing core problems in our healthcare system. Preserving patient access to care and bringing down the high costs of prescriptions is essential to ensuring the best outcomes possible for all patients.

This week, I discussed President Trump's historic joint address to Congress, my letter to Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services, and the introduction of my first piece of legislation, the Timely Departure Act.

I had a great tour of @mutcautism. They serve more than 4,000 patients right here in Missouri each year, helping them and their families navigate the challenges associated with an autism or neurodivergence diagnosis. Thank you for all you do in #MO3 and beyond! https://t.co/MXkVSOOb5V

Planned Parenthood prioritizes profit and ideology over women's health.

I was pleased to join @sbaprolife to discuss the barbaric practices of Planned Parenthood and what we can do to fight and defund it.

At a time when thousands of medical school graduates are going without a residency placement, it is a tragedy that a bureaucratic organization with a monopoly on these programs continues to shut so many of them down.

Hear my thoughts on this from today's @JudiciaryGOP hearing below.

Thank you Secretary Lori Chavez-DeRemer for joining the @EdWorkforceCmte. Employer provided health insurance plans are vital to many households across the country. We must ensure the options for employers and employees are high quality and low cost. 

Listen to my remarks on this with @SecretaryLCD 👇

"Generations of bad health policy have moved Americans away from choice and competition and quality and in the direction of consolidation and single payer healthcare."

One of the few bright spots in our healthcare system are Associated Health Plans. 

Today, I was happy to speak in support of Chairman @RepWalberg's "Association Health Plans Act."

All businesses deserve the ability to choose the best healthcare plan possible for them and their employees. That's why I was proud to hold a vote on my bill, the Self Insurance Protection Act, in @EdWorkforceCmte, to ensure small businesses retain equal access to stop-loss insurance plans.

I was pleased to meet with the team at @DaVita dialysis in Lake St. Louis yesterday and hear about the important work they’re doing with patients who have kidney disease. 

Thank you for having me! https://t.co/vFzrwbuLkA

What happened to “Do No Harm” - a Doctor’s sacred oath?

Chloe is one of thousands of children tragically misled by medical practitioners. Her story is heartbreaking, but it must be told - and it must be learned from. No child, and no parent, should ever be forced to endure this kind of pain.

‼️To read more about the Chloe Cole Act click here:https://t.co/9S5BoaTtWy

The American people can decide for themselves.

Here’s Chuck Schumer railing against a system rife with fraud that extends taxpayer-funded healthcare to illegal aliens.

Now? He’s threatening to shut down the government unless those very benefits are protected.

This is not negotiation. It’s reckless grandstanding.

House Republicans have already done our job. We passed a clean CR to keep America open, safe, and secure.

The @ThomasMoreSoc is driven by the pursuit for justice.

They understand why the Chloe Cole Act is so important. It empowers victims. It gives families the chance to demand justice. And it finally holds the medical establishment accountable.

This would be a true victory - for children, for families, and for America’s future.

On September 19th, House Republicans delivered - we passed a clean funding bill to keep the government open for the American people.

Democrats continue to vote to prolong this shutdown.

The government could be open today, but Democrats are too focused on giving free healthcare to illegal aliens.

I joined my colleagues in speaking out against the FDA’s approval of mifepristone.

As a physician, I know every medication carries risk - and responsible doctors always assess those risks before prescribing. https://t.co/5jDBUDSln4

✂️It was a privilege to join the ribbon-cutting ceremony at @MemorialCounty hospital to celebrate their new CT machine!

A major step forward in delivering faster, more accurate diagnostic care for patients across #MO03 and surrounding communities. https://t.co/kr1IfnGkF0

Honored to lead my @RepublicanStudy colleagues in a letter officially sent this morning to @SecScottBessent, urging decisive action to remove sex-trait altering surgeries and drug therapies from the IRS list of qualified medical expenses.

Taxpayer dollars should never be used to subsidize irreversible procedures that harm the American people.

We’re tired of saying it - Congress has work to do. But that can’t happen if Democrats continue prioritizing their radical agenda over the American people.

Let’s be clear: Republicans will not vote to fund healthcare for illegal immigrants. It’s reckless, it’s unfair, and it’s wrong. 

All Democrats need to do is vote for a clean CR - the same one they’ve supported 14x before. It’s sitting in the Senate, ready for a vote.

When will enough be enough?

Through this government shutdown, the Democrats primary talking point has been extending subsidies for Obamacare - an unmitigated failure that has driven premiums up, while lowering the quality of care for hardworking Americans.

After months of unnecessary gridlock, Democrats ultimately agreed to the SAME DEAL they were offered on September 30th.

I commend the eight Senate Democrats who finally recognized the harm this shutdown was causing. Now, we can focus on delivering health care that actually benefits the American people...

⬇️Listen to my full interview with @AVPMikeFerguson below!

I questioned witnesses in @JudiciaryGOP about the financial impact of extending Obamacare subsidies.

In the words of healthcare expert Dr. Brian Blase, “Obamacare is inherently inflationary.”

Extending subsidies in their current form doesn’t solve the problem—it masks it, and allows a flawed program with deteriorating outcomes to continue driving costs higher for American families.
